_comment: mi300x is measured (avg 1.39s/pipe over 25 repetitions on MI300X on OCI with use_torch_compile: true, ~2x margin applied); mi350 is measured (avg 0.92s/pipe over 25 repetitions, consistent across two separate MI350 nodes with use_torch_compile: true, ~2x margin applied); auto/mi355 remain unvalidated placeholders.
